# Acqua Rinova Group

> Acqua Rinova Group (Pty) Ltd is a water-first company based in Johannesburg, South Africa, established in 2026. It helps mines and farms that share a catchment plan their water under changing climate conditions, and assesses mine water and surplus mine land as productive inputs for agriculture. Tagline: "The intelligence beneath every drop."

## What the company does

- Scenario water budgets: re-runs mine site water balances and farm water budgets at 80%, 60% and 40% of normal rainfall, with a high-heat case.
- Licence and allocation review: water use licences, irrigation rights, carry-over rules and curtailment exposure.
- Monitoring discipline: borehole telemetry, abstraction logs, flow meters and soil moisture probes.
- Productive mine-water reuse through Blue Harvest Projects, its water-agriculture division, using the Rows and Roots discovery tool.
- Acqua Nexus: a water decision-making tool in development that brings site, farm and catchment data into one view.

## Who it serves

- Mining houses with dewatering volumes and surplus infrastructure land
- Commercial agriculture and irrigation schemes in shared catchments
- Lenders, insurers and Development Finance Institutions (DFIs)
- Community and Social and Labour Plan (SLP) teams

Primary geography: Southern Africa.

## Brand structure

Acqua Rinova Group (parent) > Acqua Nexus (water decision-making tool) > Blue Harvest Projects (water-agriculture division) > Rows and Roots (agriculture discovery tool within Blue Harvest Projects).
